summary: Apply AfCFTA origin rules, customs procedures, and coordination tools. Explore the practical course outline and enquire about training.
lede: AfCFTA implementation training helps trade and customs professionals turn trade provisions into practical origin checks and border procedures. Participants practise interpreting product-specific origin rules, screening tariff preference eligibility, preparing origin evidence, mapping customs and transit processes, and tracking implementation actions with an Excel-based dashboard.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who translate AfCFTA commitments into customs, export, logistics, and regional coordination work. It is suitable for trade professionals who handle operational procedures as well as specialists who advise on policy and market access.
modules: AfCFTA Trade Architecture and Market Access
Rules of Origin and Product Qualification
prerequisites: Recommended: working familiarity with cross-border trade, customs processes, export documentation, or trade policy. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software such as Excel if you want to complete the digital tracking exercises; no specific software installation is assumed.
